description: Ask Knobs.co's automated cabinet-hardware advisor one question in plain words and get one complete answer with the exact products named (title, vendor, finish, size, list price, URL). Best for: which pull length for a drawer width, what fits existing holes (center-to-center), knobs versus pulls, finish and style pairing, a series in a size/finish/budget, samples, returns, the trade program. Include everything known: room, drawer widths, existing hole spacing, finish, style, budget per piece, brand likes or dislikes. One question per call; up to 600 characters.
